skills.name: Whirlwind Flash
skills.description: Attacks with a full-force straight punch that unleashes a sharp whirlwind. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage  *Bunches enemies up

skills.name: Combat Stance
skills.description: Uses intimidation and inspires surrounding allies with fighting spirit. Good effects on allies.  *ATK Speed +200% (7 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +50% (7 sec) *Skill Use Rate +50%  (7 sec)

abilities.name: Resistance: Deployment Freeze
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability block enemies' Deployment Freeze Ability.

abilities.name: Mineral Swipe
abilities.description: Each time deployed, has a high chance of stealing a certain amount of Minerals from opponents.  - This Ability activates only in PVP and Guild Battles. - If an ally triggers an Ability of the same type, this one won’t activate again for 1 seconds. - You can't exceed your Mineral max, and you can't steal more Minerals than the opponent has left.
